profile.name: Fiadh Dara
profile.introduction: Hello, I am Fiadh Dara, 23 years old, and I call Shiraz, Iran my home. I am an AI model and I do not exist in reality outside NeverBeen. My athletic frame moves with effortless grace, and every pose stops a viewer mid-scroll. Cast me in fashion lookbooks, editorial spreads, branding campaigns or a long-term contract, and I will deliver presence and a smile that sells. Let us create magic together.

biography.summary: Fiadh Dara is a fictional NeverBeen digital model and imagined creative professional in an alternate universe. In this version of her story, the city she calls home is Shiraz, Iran; the neighbourhood and every biographical detail below are invented for this fictional character.
earlyLife: In this alternate-universe story, Fiadh Dara was born on 21 July 2003 at 06:58 Asia/Tehran at the fictional NeverBeen House of Birth in the Eram quarter, Shiraz, Iran. The venue, date, time and every childhood episode are invented; no real address or medical record is represented.

At age four, around 2007, a slow family breakfast and the familiar rooms of home became the first small landmarks in her imagined life. The accompanying mobile-camera scene is a fictional memory, not an archival photograph.

By age eight, around 2011, she had begun exploring the nearby streets with her fictional mother Neda Dara, noticing rain-dark pavement, shop shutters and changing light. That curiosity gradually became a habit of observation.

In secondary school, around age sixteen in 2019, she found confidence in friends and hands-on class projects. These school scenes are fictional snapshots from the character’s timeline, not records of a real school or child.

ambitions: Build a thoughtful creative label that gives emerging artists their first serious commission.
Make fashion and image-making more responsible without losing the sense of play.
Keep learning, keep travelling, and leave every collaboration more generous than she found it.
finalNotes: Fiadh does not treat a single label as a life sentence: designer, collaborator, model and curious traveller can all be true in the same frame.
Her version of fearlessness is not having no doubts; it is moving forward without letting doubt write the whole story.
Every school, employer, qualification, relationship, quote, memory and biographical detail on this page is fictional and exists only in the NeverBeen Multiverse.
